{"tool": "write_file", "input": {"path": "models/mart/dim_tournament.sql", "content": "{{ config(
    tags=["mart", "dimension"]
  )
}}

with matches as (
    select *
      from {{ ref('stg_atp_tour__matches') }}
)
, ref_unknown_record as (
    select *
      from {{ ref('ref_unknown_values') }}
)
, tournament_agg as (
    select tournament_sk as dim_tournament_key
          ,tournament_id
          ,tournament_name
          ,tournament_level
          ,tournament_date
          ,surface
          ,draw_size
          ,count(*) as num_of_matches
      from matches
     group by 1,2,3,4,5,6,7
)
, unknown_record as (
    select cast(u.unknown_key as varchar) as dim_tournament_key
          ,cast(u.unknown_key as varchar) as tournament_id
          ,u.unknown_text as tournament_name
          ,u.unknown_text as tournament_level
          ,u.unknown_date as tournament_date
          ,u.unknown_text as surface
          ,u.unknown_integer as draw_size
          ,u.unknown_integer as num_of_matches
      from ref_unknown_record u

    union all

    select cast(dim_tournament_key as varchar) as dim_tournament_key
          ,tournament_id
          ,tournament_name
          ,tournament_level
          ,tournament_date
          ,surface
          ,draw_size
          ,num_of_matches
      from tournament_agg
)
select *
  from unknown_record
"}}
